title: Decision JM-2: keyPackageRef encoded with its TLS length prefix
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (5630c10) gives no example for keyPackageRef/invalidProposals. Readings: base64url of the full TLS encoding including the varint length prefix (the draft's general byte-string rule; what KeyPackageRef::as_bytes holds) vs the raw 32-byte hash. Chosen: TLS encoding with the prefix. Draft example requested (via crate-jmap-50).
